desc:
🆕 UPDATE: WORLD 2 · THE SWAMP!
🐜 Ant race, ✂️ beauty salon, 💨 gases, 🐸 frogs, 🪞 mirrors, and 🌿 carnivorous plants
👑 Defeat the Swamp Queen and win her crown!
🍄 New mushrooms and leaves, much stronger
➡️ Reach the Fairy Tree and enter through the portal

🤫 Don't splash! The Prilili can hear you...
The Prilili (Prili Prili), the fairies who went viral on TikTok, live in this pond. They look cute... but if you fall into the water, they'll scream at you! 🧚💦

🍃 Fly over the water with your umbrella leaf
🍄 Bounce on the trampoline mushrooms
🐸 Challenges in each pond: frogs, droplets, waves, ambushes…
🏆 Win on the leaderboards and upgrade your sword
👑 VIP: double wins on pink plates

👫 Up to 8 players per server · 🎧 Best with headphones

A horror game similar to <Don't Splash>: How far can you get without splashing? 🤫
